name: BandOsMACustomSignal
summary: This EA trades based on a mean-reversion signal generated by OsMA (Moving Average of Oscillator) crossing outside Bollinger Bands applied to the OsMA itself, with exits triggered when OsMA crosses back over a moving average of OsMA. It uses a custom signal interface supporting multi-symbol and multi-timeframe operation, with trailing stop protection and a sophisticated optimization framework using shadow parameters to enforce the fast<slow constraint on MA periods.
summary_zh: 该EA基于OsMA指标跌破布林带下轨或突破上轨产生均值回归信号入场，当OsMA回穿其移动均线时出场。支持多品种多周期信号接口，配有移动止损保护，并使用影子参数优化框架确保快慢均线周期的正确约束。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是均值回归：当OsMA值跌破布林带下轨时产生做多信号，突破上轨时产生做空信号，认为价格偏离均值后会回归。入场条件为OsMA从下方穿越布林带下轨（做多）或从上方穿越上轨（做空），需要两个连续bar的穿越确认。出场条件为OsMA回穿其自身移动平均线，或者信号方向与持仓方向不一致时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数，无加仓减仓机制。资金管理方面设有止损和移动止损（止损距离的1/50作为移动步长），但无止盈设置，完全依赖信号翻转或移动止损保护利润。优化框架通过影子参数将快慢周期的二维优化转换为一维组合优化，避免无效参数组合。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is mean reversion: buy signals are generated when OsMA crosses below the Bollinger Band lower band, and sell signals when it crosses above the upper band, assuming price will revert to the mean. Entry conditions require OsMA to cross the Bollinger Band boundary on two consecutive bars — below the lower band for longs, above the upper band for shorts. Exit conditions trigger when OsMA crosses back over its own moving average, or when the current signal no longer matches the open position direction. Position sizing uses fixed lots with no scaling mechanism. Money management includes a stop loss and trailing stop (with a step of stopLoss/50), but no take-profit is set, relying entirely on signal reversal or trailing stop to protect gains. The optimization framework cleverly converts the two-dimensional fast/slow period optimization into a one-dimensional combination index using shadow parameters, eliminating invalid combinations where fast >= slow.

pros: 使用接口（interface）实现策略和信号解耦，架构清晰可扩展
影子参数优化框架巧妙解决快慢周期约束问题，减少无效优化迭代
支持多品种多周期信号，BandOsMaSignal通过参数传入品种和周期
带有移动止损机制保护浮盈，止损管理完善
使用AutoPtr智能指针管理资源，避免内存泄漏
R²判定系数作为优化准则，比单纯利润更科学
pros_en: Clean architecture with TradingStrategy/TradingSignal interfaces for decoupling and extensibility
Clever shadow parameter optimization framework eliminates invalid fast>=slow period combinations
Multi-symbol and multi-timeframe signal support via BandOsMaSignal constructor parameters
Trailing stop mechanism protects floating profits with configurable step size
AutoPtr smart pointers manage dynamic resources, preventing memory leaks
R-squared criterion for optimization is more scientifically sound than raw profit
cons: 无止盈设置，完全依赖信号翻转或移动止损，可能错失最佳出场时机
固定手数无资金管理比例调整，无法根据账户规模自适应
持仓数量超过1个时仅报警不处理，存在多仓风险
信号品种与交易品种可能不一致时无价格滑点保护
OsMA上应用布林带和MA是二次指标叠加，信号可能过度滞后
cons_en: No take-profit mechanism, fully relying on signal reversal or trailing stop which may miss optimal exits
Fixed lot sizing without proportional money management cannot adapt to account size changes
When multiple positions exist only an alert is issued without closing excess positions
No spread filter or slippage protection when trading on a different symbol than the signal symbol
Applying Bollinger Bands and MA on top of OsMA creates double-smoothing which may cause significant signal lag
improvements: 增加止盈参数或基于ATR的动态止盈，避免过度依赖信号翻转出场
加入资金管理模块，支持根据账户余额百分比或风险比例动态调整手数
增加持仓数量超限时的自动处理逻辑，而非仅报警
improvements_en: Add take-profit parameter or ATR-based dynamic take-profit to avoid over-reliance on signal reversal for exits
Implement proportional money management module that adjusts lot size based on account balance percentage or risk ratio
Add automatic handling logic for excess positions instead of just alerting when multiple positions are detected

risk_points: 多持仓情况仅报警不自动处理，可能导致意外风险敞口
无点差过滤，在小周期信号品种上交易可能受滑点影响
固定手数无法适应不同账户规模
risk_points_en: Multiple positions only trigger an alert without auto-handling, potentially leading to unintended risk exposure
No spread filter, trading on small timeframe signal symbols may suffer from slippage
Fixed lot sizing cannot adapt to varying account sizes
